conclusions: The reduced hydraulic harness can carry the externally prescribed retained-layer root sink without a sink-aggregation, sign, transaction or mass-accounting defect across U4, U8, R8 and R16.
Prescribed-root and generic-sink routes are bit-identical at the observation trajectory level.
The zero-sink capable route is bit-identical to the unmodified no-sink reduced balance.
Stage 2 therefore removes the basic harness/accounting confounder before dynamic root-feedback falsification.
No dynamic Feddes feedback has yet been evaluated and no root-specific state conclusion follows from Stage 2.
